About this fixture

This page is intentionally clean so the crawler has at least one page with no violations. It links to a PDF that must not be crawled and to an off-site page that must be ignored.

A broken link is included so HTTP errors are recorded.

Pages that check specific false positives and silent failures:

  • Custom checkbox focus
  • Translucent cards
  • Contrast exemptions
  • Hidden from assistive technology
  • Role parsing
  • Lists and short audio
  • Icon-only controls
  • Names from content
  • Contrast per line
  • Contrast below the fold
  • Contrast over images
  • Contrast with text shadows
  • Contrast of form text
  • Links told apart by color
  • Labels with embedded controls
  • Modal on load that closes
  • Modal on load that stays
